premise: Sandpiper finds two strange things on the shore: a bottle that pops its cork at him and a ball that rolls away when pecked, so he goes back to looking for small things.
inspiration: The curious-creature cumulative tale (and what's this?), ending with the little one choosing his own small world.
lesson: Big surprises are fun; small things are good too.

en-US.title: The Curious Sandpiper
en-US.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Sandpiper ran along the shore, looking for something new. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] What's this? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} A green glass bottle, rolling in the foam. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} He ran over. Tap, tap went his beak. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} POP! went the cork. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:live jump} [gasps] Sandpiper jumped right up in the air! [laughs] Then he spotted something else: {ball:enter} a big round thing, {sandpiper:go to ball by run} red and yellow and blue and white. He ran over. {sandpiper:pulse} Tap, tap. {ball:go to sand another} And away it rolled! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Sandpiper chased it, run, run, run, {ball:live spin} until it spun to a stop. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live peck} He gave it one tiny peck. Nothing happened. {sandpiper:live nod} [playfully] Good, said Sandpiper. Something that stays still. {ball:pulse} And off he went to look for tiny things, where everything was much, much smaller.

es-ES.title: El correlimos curioso
es-ES.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Correlimos corría por la orilla, buscando algo nuevo. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] ¿Y esto qué es? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Una botella de cristal verde, rodando entre la espuma. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Fue corriendo. Toc, toc, hizo su pico. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} ¡POP!, hizo el corcho. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:live jump} [gasps] ¡Correlimos dio un salto en el aire! [laughs] Luego vio otra cosa: {ball:enter} una cosa grande y redonda, {sandpiper:go to ball by run} roja, amarilla, azul y blanca. Fue corriendo. {sandpiper:pulse} Toc, toc. {ball:go to sand another} ¡Y se fue rodando! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Correlimos corrió detrás, corre, corre, corre, {ball:live spin} hasta que dio unas vueltas y se paró. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live peck} Le dio un picotazo diminuto. No pasó nada. {sandpiper:live nod} [playfully] Bien, dijo Correlimos. Algo que se queda quieto. {ball:pulse} Y se fue a buscar cositas pequeñas, donde todo era mucho, mucho más pequeño.

ja-JP.title: しりたがりの シギくん
ja-JP.text: {sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:go to shore}シギくんが、波打ち際を、ちょこちょこはしっていました。なにか、あたらしいものはないかな。{sandpiper:face happy}[curious]あれ、なんだろう？{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to shore}みどりいろのガラスのびんが、あわのなかで、ころん、ころん。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}かけよって、くちばしで、コツ、コツ。{bottle:live pop}{sfx:pop}スポンッ！コルクがとびだしました。{sandpiper:face surprised}{sandpiper:live jump}[gasps]シギくんは、ぴょーんと、とびあがりました！[laughs]それから、またべつのものを見つけました。{ball:enter}大きくて、まあるいもの。{sandpiper:go to ball by run}あか、きいろ、あお、しろ。かけよって、{sandpiper:pulse}コツ、コツ。{ball:go to sand another}ころころころーっ！{sandpiper:go to ball by run}シギくんは、おいかけます。タタタタッ…{ball:live spin}くるくるっとまわって、ぴたり。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live peck}ちょん、とひとつつき。…なんにも、おきません。{sandpiper:live nod}[playfully]「よしよし。こんどは、じっとしてる」 とシギくん。{ball:pulse}そしてシギくんは、もっと、もっと小さなものをさがしに、はしっていきました。

de-DE.title: Der neugierige Strandläufer
de-DE.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Der Strandläufer flitzte am Ufer entlang und suchte etwas Neues. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] „Was ist denn das?“ {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Eine grüne Flaschenpost, die im Schaum hin und her rollte. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Er rannte hin. Tock, tock, machte sein Schnabel. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} PLOPP! machte der Korken. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:live jump} [gasps] Der Strandläufer sprang hoch in die Luft! [laughs] Dann entdeckte er noch etwas: {ball:enter} ein großes rundes Ding, {sandpiper:go to ball by run} rot und gelb und blau und weiß. Er rannte hin. {sandpiper:pulse} Tock, tock. {ball:go to sand another} Und weg rollte es! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Der Strandläufer trippelte hinterher, trippel, trippel, trippel, {ball:live spin} bis es sich drehte und liegen blieb. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live peck} Er pickte einmal ganz zart daran. Nichts passierte. {sandpiper:live nod} [playfully] „Gut“, sagte der Strandläufer. „Endlich mal etwas, das stillhält.“ {ball:pulse} Und dann flitzte er davon, um nach winzigen Dingen zu suchen, dort, wo alles viel, viel kleiner war.

fr-FR.title: Bécasseau le curieux
fr-FR.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Bécasseau courait le long du rivage, à la recherche de quelque chose de nouveau. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] Qu’est-ce que c’est que ça ? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Une bouteille en verre vert, qui roulait dans l’écume. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Il a couru voir. Toc, toc, a fait son bec. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} POP ! a fait le bouchon. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:live jump} [gasps] Bécasseau a fait un bond en l’air ! [laughs] Puis il a aperçu autre chose : {ball:enter} une grosse chose toute ronde, {sandpiper:go to ball by run} rouge, jaune, bleue et blanche. Il a couru voir. {sandpiper:pulse} Toc, toc. {ball:go to sand another} Et la voilà partie en roulant ! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Bécasseau lui a couru après, vite, vite, vite, {ball:live spin} jusqu’à ce qu’elle tourne sur elle-même et s’arrête. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live peck} Il lui a donné un tout petit coup de bec. Rien ne s’est passé. {sandpiper:live nod} [playfully] « Parfait, a dit Bécasseau. Une chose qui ne bouge pas. » {ball:pulse} Et il est reparti chercher des choses minuscules, là où tout était beaucoup, beaucoup plus petit.

it-IT.title: Il piovanello curioso
it-IT.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Piovanello correva lungo la riva, in cerca di qualcosa di nuovo. {sandpiper:face happy} [curious] E questo, che cos'è? {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to shore} Una bottiglia di vetro verde, che rotolava nella schiuma. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} È corso a vedere. Toc, toc, ha fatto il suo becco. {bottle:live pop} {sfx:pop} POP! ha fatto il tappo. {sandpiper:face surprised} {sandpiper:live jump} [gasps] Piovanello ha fatto un salto in aria! [laughs] Poi ha visto un'altra cosa: {ball:enter} una cosa grande e tonda, {sandpiper:go to ball by run} rossa, gialla, blu e bianca. È corso a vedere. {sandpiper:pulse} Toc, toc. {ball:go to sand another} E via, è rotolata lontano! {sandpiper:go to ball by run} Piovanello le è corso dietro, corri, corri, corri, {ball:live spin} finché ha fatto una giravolta e si è fermata. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live peck} Piovanello le ha dato una beccatina piccola piccola. Non è successo niente. {sandpiper:live nod} [playfully] «Bene», ha detto Piovanello. «Una cosa che sta ferma.» {ball:pulse} E se n'è andato a cercare cosine minuscole, dove tutto era molto, molto più piccolo.

zh-TW.title: 好奇的濱鷸
zh-TW.text: {sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:go to shore}濱鷸沿著岸邊跑呀跑，想找點新鮮的東西。{sandpiper:face happy}[curious]咦，這是什麼？{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to shore}一個綠色的玻璃瓶子，在白白的浪花裡滾呀滾。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}牠跑過去，用嘴巴叩、叩敲了兩下。{bottle:live pop}{sfx:pop}啵！軟木塞跳開了。{sandpiper:face surprised}{sandpiper:live jump}[gasps]濱鷸咻地跳到半空中！[laughs]接著，牠又看到別的東西：{ball:enter}一個圓滾滾的大東西，{sandpiper:go to ball by run}紅的、黃的、藍的、白的。牠跑過去。{sandpiper:pulse}叩、叩。{ball:go to sand another}咕嚕咕嚕，它滾走了！{sandpiper:go to ball by run}濱鷸在後面追，跑呀、跑呀、跑呀，一直追到它{ball:live spin}轉了幾圈，停下來為止。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live peck}牠輕輕地啄了一小下。什麼事也沒發生。{sandpiper:live nod}[playfully]「很好，」 濱鷸說，「這個會乖乖待著不動。」 {ball:pulse}然後，牠又跑去找小東西了，找那些小小的、小小的、小很多很多的東西。

zh-HK.title: 好奇的濱鷸
zh-HK.text: {sandpiper:enter}{sandpiper:go to shore}濱鷸沿着岸邊跑呀跑，想找點新鮮的東西。{sandpiper:face happy}[curious]咦，這是甚麼？{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to shore}原來是一個綠色的玻璃瓶，在白色的泡沫裏滾來滾去。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}濱鷸跑過去，用嘴篤、篤。{bottle:live pop}{sfx:pop}啵！瓶塞彈了出來。{sandpiper:face surprised}{sandpiper:live jump}[gasps]濱鷸一下子跳到半空！[laughs]然後，牠又看見另一樣東西：{ball:enter}一個又大又圓的東西，{sandpiper:go to ball by run}紅、黃、藍、白四種顏色。牠跑過去。{sandpiper:pulse}篤、篤。{ball:go to sand another}它滾走了！{sandpiper:go to ball by run}濱鷸追呀追，跑、跑、跑，{ball:live spin}追到它轉了幾個圈，停了下來。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live peck}牠輕輕地啄了一下。甚麼也沒有發生。{sandpiper:live nod}[playfully]濱鷸說：「好喇！終於有樣嘢肯定定企。」 {ball:pulse}然後，牠又跑去找小小的東西了，那邊的東西，全都小得多、小得多。
